scope: Frontend controls, icons and on-demand territorial search. No backend, database, deployment, or source-data changes.

notAdded: another icon catalogue or chart engine

notes: Compressed file sizes; transport compression depends on deployment.
Optional search file downloads only on explicit long-list search intent. No prefetch on page/sheet open.
MapLibre JavaScript and worker sizes remain essentially unchanged.

verification.screenshots: Reviewed desktop/mobile search controls and the existing map/trends/reporting layouts.

behaviorEvidence.behavior: Short native lists, local name/UBIGEO search, accent matching, no-match value preservation, bounded results, disabled fields and return to native mode
tests: retains native selection for short lists
opens search only on intent, matches accents and UBIGEO, and keeps the native alternative
bounds rendered matches and disables both modes with their field

behaviorEvidence.behavior: No initial search download, no API per keystroke, keyboard selection, nested Escape, preserved complete native options and parent reset
behaviorEvidence.test: long territorial search loads on intent, filters locally and preserves native selection

behaviorEvidence.behavior: Optional chunk failure keeps original filter usable
behaviorEvidence.test: failed optional search download retains the complete native filter

mobileLab.environment: Headless Chromium, Pixel7 viewport with touch taps,4x CPU slowdown, local production build; synthetic API fixtures and software WebGL; times include designed CSS transitions and requestAnimationFrame polling, not INP or physical phone measurements.
limits: Five samples per open/close action, emulated Pixel7 touch viewport,4x CPU slowdown and software WebGL.
Synthetic API fixtures; does not measure real data-query or geometry performance.
DOM/requestAnimationFrame response proxy, not INP or physical-phone Core Web Vitals.
Small changes in medians are not proof of improved real-device performance.

remaining: Physical iOS/Android soft-keyboard and scrolling verification
